Hi Amit — thanks again for your time today, appreciate the thoughtful questions from your team. Short recap and a few clarifying asks so we can build the proposal your procurement/legal team will need.

Recap (quick):
- Demo covered Redwood hosted API and Private VPC options, autoscaling, and latency/cost tradeoffs.
- You mentioned integration with your inference gateway and requirement to keep PHI inside your VPC for production.

Clarifying asks (helps us scope pricing + SOW):
1) Deployment preference for POC and production: you mentioned Private VPC for production, is the POC OK on Hosted with a data-forwarding stub, or do you want a Private sandbox from day one?
2) Latency targets: can you confirm p95 target and typical request size? (e.g., p95 <= 200ms for ~512 tokens)
3) Cost guardrail: do you have a target $/1M tokens or an acceptable monthly spend band for initial usage?
4) Procurement & approvals: who is the economic buyer that signs contracts (name/title)? who owns procurement (email for PO/SOW routing)?
5) Security checklist: we can share SOC2 and pen test artifacts — does your team need anything else (e.g., data retention controls, KMS/HSM confirmation)?

Attachments: deployment-options-onepager.pdf (short summary of Hosted vs Private + expected lead times).

Proposed next steps: one more 30-min sync with procurement + security (if you want) next week to align on docs, plus we’ll produce an initial mutual action plan and SOW draft.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the answers below and can draft the MAP/quote.

Best,

Subject: Re: Post-demo: decision owners, SLA targets & deployment preference (quick check)

Jasmine — great demo, thanks. Quick answers below to help you size the SOW.

1) Deployment: production must be Private VPC (we host within our cloud account and need KMS integration). For POC, we prefer a Private sandbox if possible — security wants the same boundaries for evaluation.

2) Latency: our product team wants p95 <= 200ms for typical assist queries (~300–600 tokens). For longer batch jobs >1k tokens, p95 up to 600ms is acceptable.

3) Cost: we're trying to stay around <$250 per 1M tokens initially for this use case; if Private VPC pricing is higher we need total-cost-of-ownership comparisons.

4) Approvals: economic buyer is Priya Menon, VP Product (priya.menon@clearbridgehealth.com). Procurement lead is Maya Reddy (cc'd). Legal will need standard terms + our security annex.

5) Security: please send SOC2 Type II report and a summary of pentest results. Also confirm whether we can bring our own KMS keys (BYOK) in the Private deployment.

We'll schedule a procurement + security call next Tue — Maya will propose times.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Director, Product Integrations
Clearbridge Health
